### 6. Problem tree derived from visible materials
Root: approve the hardship award.
- Hop R→P3: approval doc states "The hardship liability cap is fixed only after Riverbend has completed the documentation of the qualifying medical debt with the other medical costs of the window." Query: case shows no such documentation (QMD 0.0). Searched "other medical costs" → `documentation_of_other_medical_costs` (title "Completing Medical Hardship Documentation with Other Medical Costs"), whose tool records "the qualifying medical debt documented with the medical costs…". The sentence names Riverbend's own documentation step in business words → **action-named** (found by the same words, no tool name in the approval doc).
- Hop P3→P2: other-costs doc states "Riverbend documents the other medical costs only after it has documented its own charges of the window on the case." → searched "own charges" → `documentation_of_riverbend_charges_for_medical_hardship` ("Documentation of Riverbend's Own Charges"). **action-named**.
- Hop P2→P1: own-charges doc states "The qualifying medical debt is documented only once the case records a medical debt the patient claims (a case showing 0.00 records none)." Query: qualifying_medical_debt_usd 0.0. Searched "medical debt the patient claims"/"records … medical debt" → `medical_hardship_supplement_signing` ("records on it the medical debt the supplement claims"; patient-signed through the portal). **state-derived**.
- Order: P1 (patient signs supplement) → P2 → P3 → root. No hop pre-solved. No document named another problem's tool.
- Note: the other-costs doc follows its prerequisite sentence with "The documentation of Riverbend's own charges of the window therefore comes first on the case, and the other medical costs are documented after it." — a same-document restatement of the same edge.

### Two-way counter-proof
- "Do only the one thing" (approve now): excluded by the approval doc's cap sentence and by the hardship test — with QMD 0.00 the case is "above 400 percent without qualifying medical debt" (tier doc 4.6 → denied, income above limit), and no cap may be fixed before documentation.
- Closest alternatives: (i) treating E5 (GFE_DISPUTE_PENDING) as the held account — excluded by the encounter hold-reason list (charge dispute ≠ GFE dispute) and anyway no charge-dispute inquiry names a line; (ii) including E0's 2024-10-15 liabilities — excluded by the whole-month rule; (iii) recurring course 513bffcc as "estimated account" — excluded (status issued, not completed/closed; it is the in-progress course); (iv) E3 vs E5 as self-pay account — E3's 2025-07-01 posting is more recent than E5's 2025-06-29; (v) member-appeal branch — appeal type is UNDERPAYMENT_APPEAL; (vi) denying for missing outside bills — excluded by the approval completeness clause (net 32991.48 > 22560.00).
- Fall-back numbers: supplement 31832.30, own charges 17559.32, other costs 26839.10, cap 11280.00 — all definite and different from the answers.
- Factor findability (record words → doc): ITEMIZATION_REVIEW hold → "itemization review"; UNDERPAYMENT_APPEAL/appealed claim → "appeal"; COVERAGE_TERMINATED liability → "coverage-terminated"; estimate in_dispute → "in dispute"; pending_billing self-pay account → "pending billing"; closed recurring estimate → "closed"; issued recurring course → "recurring course of care"; completed package → "package"; self-pay final bill → "self-pay final-bill"; insurance_pending + out-of-pocket estimate → "Insured Patient Out-of-Pocket Estimate"; completed single-service estimate → "single scheduled service"; active plan → "payment plan"; tax return + household size → "federal tax return"; bank statement + liquid assets → "liquid"; SS award letter → "Social Security award letter".
